Programs Krishna School of Technology 4 Programs KSET Message from the Director Dr. Lalit S Thakur Director, KSET Dear Students, Faculty, and Esteemed Colleagues, Welcome to Krishna School of Emerging Technology and Applied Research (KSET) - a constituent institute of Drs. Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara, one of Gujarat's top private engineering universities. KSET is committed to delivering globally competitive engineering education that prepares students for careers across Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electric Vehicles, and other high-demand technology sectors. At KSET, engineering is more than a discipline - it is a platform to solve the world's most complex challenges. Our curriculum is continuously updated to reflect advances in emerging technologies, ensuring our graduates are career-ready from day one with skills that industry demands. We combine academic rigor with real-world application, mentored research, and strong industry alliances, creating an environment where curiosity thrives, innovation is a way of life, and every student is prepared to lead. What We Provide AICTE-approved, industry-aligned curriculum World-class faculty with research and industry expertise Advanced labs and modern campus infrastructure Active placement cell with 100+ hiring partners VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Our Vision “To be a globally recognized center of excellence in technical education, research, and innovation -
